scope: Evidence-backed implementation coverage, not confirmation of manuscript results. PASS pertains only to the specified limited check.

claims.claim: Patient-level separation
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Checks provided partitions for overlapping patients; no paper cohort partitions are available.

claims.claim: H&E non-overlapping 256-pixel tiles at 20x and Otsu tissue threshold
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Slide loading, tiling, and thresholding are absent.

claims.claim: CONCH ViT-B/16 visual encoder
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Official model and gated weights not present; feature-level interface does not substitute for the encoder.

claims.claim: Top 2000 highly variable genes and niche means
claims.evidence_or_limitation: HVG selection and aggregation are absent.

claims.claim: Omics MLP, hidden 512, batch normalization and GELU
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Layer dimensions and operators represented; ordering is an engineering choice and no real-data validation was performed.

claims.claim: Six-neighbour mean and variance, attention-pooled slide, feature projection
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Concatenation uses 4d because the four stated feature blocks contradict the 3d manuscript description. Attention form is unspecified and chosen as an engineering default.

claims.claim: Symmetric cosine InfoNCE, initial temperature 0.07
claims.evidence_or_limitation: End-to-end validation on the reported paired data and vision encoder has not been completed.

claims.claim: Atlas reference and cell2location deconvolution
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Reference preparation and deconvolution are absent.

claims.claim: 15-nearest-neighbour Gaussian graph using median nearest distance
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Graph symmetrisation and biological label features are not specified or implemented; cohort-level validation has not been completed.

claims.claim: Leiden clustering and biological annotations
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Clustering, resolution search and annotation absent.

claims.claim: Pretraining 50 epochs AdamW 0.0005, decay 0.01 and 500-step warmup cosine
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Full optimizer schedule and training loop absent; effective batch arithmetic conflicts in the manuscript.

claims.claim: Fine-tuning 100 epochs with layer-wise rates and patience 15
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Backbone, discriminative learning rates, validation and early stopping absent.

claims.claim: Image and molecular augmentations, stain normalization
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Not implemented.

claims.claim: Resistance classifier and Cox model
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Outcomes, fitted classifiers, survival analysis and validation absent.

claims.claim: ARI and NMI
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Held-out patient evaluation has not been completed.

claims.claim: AUROC and sensitivity specificity F1 at Youden threshold
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Threshold selection on evaluation labels would leak information; cohort evaluation has not been completed.

claims.claim: Concordance index log-rank and Pearson gene correlation
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Not implemented.

claims.claim: POSTN barrier attention, linear probing and signature analysis
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Not implemented; unavailable paired data and annotations.

claims.claim: Permutation tests, Holm correction and BCa bootstrap intervals
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Not implemented.

claims.claim: Baseline comparisons, all reported tables, ablations and subgroup analyses
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Not independently evaluated; paper states that some baseline values were estimated from published benchmarks.

claims.claim: HEST spatial transcriptomics and histology regions joined by barcode
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Actual HEST benchmark HCC sample NCBI642: 1941 patches matched by barcode, one selected-expression row and coordinates independently checked. 224-pixel input explicitly selected for validation; 256-pixel default correctly rejects it. This does not validate feature extraction, gene selection or reported experiments.

claims.claim: HEST standard benchmark splits
claims.evidence_or_limitation: Actual HCC fold-0 train and test CSVs parsed and sample identifiers differ. Patient-level disjointness cannot be verified without a sample-to-patient mapping.

claims.claim: TCGA-LIHC clinical metadata
claims.evidence_or_limitation: 25 actual GDC cases parsed; 20 had a reported stage and 25 a vital status. Exact frozen split, treatment labels and outcome prediction not verified.
